title: Base change along a field extension is faithfully flat
statement: Let $K'/K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and let $D$ be a commutative $K$-algebra. Then the ring map $D\to D\otimes_KK'$, $d\mapsto d\otimes1$, is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra: $K'$ is a free $K$-module with a nonempty basis, hence faithfully flat over $K$ (flat by Definition Tag 00HB, and $K'\otimes_KN\neq0$ for $N\neq0$, so faithfully flat by Lemma Tag 00HP lemma-ff (2)), and faithful flatness is preserved by base change (Lemma Tag 00HI lemma-flat-base-change, line 8889); used in the proof of Lemma Tag 0381 Step 4 ('the faithfully flat ring map K otimes_k A -> K' otimes_k A')

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line, by instances: K' is a free K-module (Module.Free.of_divisionRing, Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/VectorSpace.lean:156) and nontrivial (a field), so Module.FaithfullyFlat K K' (unnamed instance at FaithfullyFlat/Basic.lean:209, [Nontrivial M] [Module.Free R M]); the base-change instance at Basic.lean:559 with R := K, M := K', S := D gives Module.FaithfullyFlat D (D ⊗[K] K'), the D-module structure being the left one, i.e. the ring map d ↦ d ⊗ 1 (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft); this is the node's notion by [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
